title: Grok Build 0.1: Intelligence, Performance and Price Analysis
summary: Artificial Analysis published a detailed benchmark analysis comparing xAI's Grok Build 0.1 model across intelligence metrics, raw performance, and cost-effectiveness pricing tiers. The article provides comparative data against other frontier models like GPT-4 and Claude.
problem_solved: Provides comprehensive model comparison data to help developers and enterprises make informed decisions about which AI model to use based on performance-to-cost ratios.
why_valuable: Offers objective, data-driven benchmarking that cuts through marketing claims, enabling evidence-based model selection for production deployments.
